newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Digital files for 1.7 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Digital files for 1.7 mln shares.

text.p: Advanced Digital Information Corp said Monday it filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 1,725,000 common shares.

Of the total, 1.7 million common will be offered for sale by the company and 25,000 common shares will be sold by a Walter Kistler, a director. After the offering, outstanding common will total 9,859,176 common.
Net proceeds will be used for working capital and other general corporate purposes, the filing said.
The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 258,750 additional shares. The offering will be made through Hambrecht & Quist and Dain Bosworth Inc.
Advanced Digital is a provider of automated tape libraries and standalone tape drives used to back up and archive electronic data in client/server network computing environments.
